'''Tales of the Jedi''' was an illegal [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]]. It was available for sale at the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]], starting at a price of 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="WHSV" />
